Broadstreet Consulting Can Help Grow Your Business Using Google AdWords Campaigns

November 2019 Client Highlight:

Conversion rates can be a business owner’s most frustrating numbers. Second only to cost per conversion numbers. 

We at Broadstreet Consulting utilize industry standards and knowledge of consumer behaviors to improve impressions, click-thru-rates and - most importantly - reduce your costs to reach potential customers. 

Recently, we presented a 3-month progress report to a client with some pretty impressive stats since making improvements to their existing AdWords campaigns. With our help, they saw:

  • Search network click-thru-rate increase from .82% to 1.13%, conversion rate increase from about 1% to about 3%, and cost per conversion decreased by more than $50.
  • The cost per conversion in shopping campaign decreased from over $100 to less than $30, while the conversion rate increased from .84% to 2.83%.
  • The display campaign created received over 400K impressions and 3,075 clicks, with a cost per click of only $.13.
  • An overall savings of about $1,000 from July to September

Need some help improving your numbers? Looking to get a better bottom line from your digital advertising? Contact us today!
